system.notes: The Titanoi are mysterious and inscrutable beings, and so too can Zoran sorcerers be. This sorcerous effect causes the Zoran’s body to twist and shift and alter, transforming them completely into a Hellene for a small span of time. Their mental and physical Attributes do not change, but for the duration of the effect, they are a Hellene completely and totally. It is said that Zoran spies often use such sorcery to fool unwitting guards. But the Titanoi are fickle patrons; sorcerers who botch this effect have been known to be transformed into all manner of different shapes and find it difficult to return to their true form.
